hints.content: For this particular slope field, the segments that appear along the line $\displaystyle~y=2x~$ are all horizontal and thus satisfy the condition that$\displaystyle~\frac{dy}{dx}=0\,$. If we make this substitution into each of the choices, only  $\displaystyle~\frac{dy}{dx}=2x-y~$ gives an output of $\displaystyle~0~$ when $~y=2x\,$.
